case_for: Deeptech/vertical AI with a clear enterprise buyer (S1, R4).
Pilots appear to be running with warehouse customers (R2, R3).
Compact form factor is a specific, globally relevant angle (S4, R6).
case_against: Pilot-to-rollout conversion uncertain and long enterprise sales cycles (R3, R4).
Hardware margins unproven at scale; capital needs may exceed a pre-seed cheque (R5).
Better-funded global competitors; co-investor-led round the fund may not lead (R6, S2).
call_questions: How many pilots are live, and which has converted to a paid rollout, at what price?
What is gross margin per unit today and at 100 units?
How long from first meeting to signed order with your last customer?
Why do customers pick you over the better-funded global players?
If no pilot converts in the next nine months, what does that tell you, and what do you change?
what_would_change_our_view: At least one pilot converted to a paid multi-site rollout with unit margins shown would change our view.
